+# Four-path nearest-ray comparison
+
+## Abstract
+
+The nearest-ray Kraus estimate separates trace-defect and coordinate-distance errors and preserves the source constants after finite summation.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Finite-family error aggregation).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/Recovery/FourPathNearestRayComparison.finite_family_error_aggregation`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/Recovery/FourPathNearestRayComparison.finite_family_error_aggregation` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For a finite family of matrix errors K - B = E + F, if the squared norms of E and F are bounded by 2τ and c d² termwise, then the summed squared error is bounded by 4Στ + 2cΣd².
+
+The proof applies the squared triangle estimate pointwise and then distributes the finite sums.
+
+**Theorem 1.2 (Selected mass bounds and defect).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/Recovery/FourPathNearestRayComparison.selected_mass_bounds_and_defect`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/Recovery/FourPathNearestRayComparison.selected_mass_bounds_and_defect` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For nonnegative coordinate weights with unit total mass, assigning each index to its larger coordinate yields selected masses in [0,1]. The two complementary masses sum to the finite sum of coordinatewise minima.
+
+The proof partitions each coordinate by the selected Boolean assignment and uses the completeness sums.
+

+import D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.FourPathWeightedEqualityRemainder
+import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+/-! Finite-family aggregation for the nearest-ray Kraus comparison. -/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix.Norms.Frobenius
+
+namespace D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.FourPathNearestRayComparison
+
+abbrev Index := Fin 4
+
+private lemma norm_add_sq_le (x y : Matrix Index Index ℂ) :
+    ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hnorm : ‖x + y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
+  have hsq : ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) ^ 2 := by
+    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).2 hnorm
+  calc
+    ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) ^ 2 := hsq
+    _ ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
+      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖x‖ - ‖y‖)]
+
+/-- A finite family of two-term Hilbert--Schmidt errors satisfies the summed
+quadratic estimate used in the nearest-ray Kraus comparison. -/
+theorem finite_family_error_aggregation
+    {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
+    (K B E F : J → Matrix Index Index ℂ)
+    (τ dSq : J → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
+    (hdecomp : ∀ j, K j - B j = E j + F j)
+    (hE : ∀ j, ‖E j‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * τ j)
+    (hF : ∀ j, ‖F j‖ ^ 2 ≤ c * dSq j) :
+    ∑ j, ‖K j - B j‖ ^ 2 ≤
+      4 * (∑ j, τ j) + 2 * c * (∑ j, dSq j) := by
+  have hpoint : ∀ j, ‖K j - B j‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * τ j + 2 * c * dSq j := by
+    intro j
+    rw [hdecomp j]
+    calc
+      ‖E j + F j‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖E j‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖F j‖ ^ 2 :=
+        norm_add_sq_le (E j) (F j)
+      _ ≤ 4 * τ j + 2 * c * dSq j := by
+        nlinarith [hE j, hF j]
+  calc
+    ∑ j, ‖K j - B j‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (4 * τ j + 2 * c * dSq j) := by
+      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hpoint j)
+    _ = 4 * (∑ j, τ j) + 2 * c * (∑ j, dSq j) := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
+
+/-- The selected larger-coordinate masses have the complementary defect given by
+the sum of the coordinatewise smaller masses. -/
+theorem selected_mass_bounds_and_defect
+    {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
+    (p q : J → ℝ) (σ : J → Bool)
+    (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hq : ∀ j, 0 ≤ q j)
+    (hsumP : ∑ j, p j = 1) (hsumQ : ∑ j, q j = 1)
+    (hsel : ∀ j, (σ j = true ∧ q j ≤ p j) ∨ (σ j = false ∧ p j < q j)) :
+    0 ≤ (∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) ∧
+      (∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) ≤ 1 ∧
+      0 ≤ (∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) ∧
+      (∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) ≤ 1 ∧
+      (1 - (∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0)) +
+          (1 - (∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j)) =
+        (∑ j, min (p j) (q j)) := by
+  have hplus_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0 := by
+    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by
+      by_cases hs : σ j = true <;> simp [hs, hp j])
+  have hplus_le : (∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) ≤ ∑ j, p j := by
+    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by
+      by_cases hs : σ j = true <;> simp [hs, hp j])
+  have hminus_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j := by
+    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by
+      by_cases hs : σ j = true <;> simp [hs, hq j])
+  have hminus_le : (∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) ≤ ∑ j, q j := by
+    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by
+      by_cases hs : σ j = true <;> simp [hs, hq j])
+  have hpoint : ∀ j,
+      (p j - (if σ j = true then p j else 0)) +
+          (q j - (if σ j = true then 0 else q j)) = min (p j) (q j) := by
+    intro j
+    rcases hsel j with ⟨hs, hqp⟩ | ⟨hs, hpq⟩
+    · simp [hs, min_eq_right hqp]
+    · simp [hs, min_eq_left hpq.le]
+  refine ⟨hplus_nonneg, hplus_le.trans_eq hsumP, hminus_nonneg,
+    hminus_le.trans_eq hsumQ, ?_⟩
+  calc
+    (1 - ∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) +
+        (1 - ∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) =
+        ((∑ j, p j) - ∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) +
+          ((∑ j, q j) - ∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) := by
+            rw [hsumP, hsumQ]
+    _ = ∑ j, ((p j - (if σ j = true then p j else 0)) +
+          (q j - (if σ j = true then 0 else q j))) := by
+            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
+              Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+    _ = ∑ j, min (p j) (q j) := by
+      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hpoint j)
+
+end D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.FourPathNearestRayComparison

+noncomputable section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

+namespace Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.FourPathNearestRayComparison

+abbrev signature : Signature where
+  Params := Unit
+  State _ := Bool
+  Role := Unit
+  finiteRole := inferInstance
+  nonemptyRole := inferInstance
+  Output _ _ := Bool
+  Anchor := Empty
+  finiteAnchor := inferInstance
+
+def actual : Realization signature :=
+  realize signature (fun _ _ b => b) (fun e _ => nomatch e)
+
+def rejected : Realization signature :=
+  realize signature (fun _ _ _ => false) (fun e _ => nomatch e)
+
+abbrev arena : Arena where
+  signature := signature
+  Law obs := ∀ {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
+    (K B E F : J → Matrix Index Index ℂ) (τ dSq : J → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
+    (hdecomp : ∀ j, K j - B j = E j + F j) →
+    (hE : ∀ j, ‖E j‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * τ j) →
+    (hF : ∀ j, ‖F j‖ ^ 2 ≤ c * dSq j) →
+    (obs.readout () () true = true) ∧
+      (∑ j, ‖K j - B j‖ ^ 2 ≤
+        4 * (∑ j, τ j) + 2 * c * (∑ j, dSq j))
+
+abbrev claim : Prop := ∀ {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
+    (K B E F : J → Matrix Index Index ℂ) (τ dSq : J → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
+    (∀ j, K j - B j = E j + F j) →
+    (∀ j, ‖E j‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * τ j) →
+    (∀ j, ‖F j‖ ^ 2 ≤ c * dSq j) →
+    4 * (∑ j, τ j) + 2 * c * (∑ j, dSq j) ≥ ∑ j, ‖K j - B j‖ ^ 2
+
+theorem actual_law : arena.Law actual := by
+  intro J inst K B E F τ dSq c hdecomp hE hF
+  exact ⟨rfl, finite_family_error_aggregation K B E F τ dSq c hdecomp hE hF⟩
+
+theorem rejected_law : ¬ arena.Law rejected := by
+  intro h
+  let J := ULift Unit
+  let K : J → Matrix Index Index ℂ := fun _ => 0
+  let B : J → Matrix Index Index ℂ := fun _ => 0
+  let E : J → Matrix Index Index ℂ := fun _ => 0
+  let F : J → Matrix Index Index ℂ := fun _ => 0
+  let τ : J → ℝ := fun _ => 0
+  let dSq : J → ℝ := fun _ => 0
+  have hh := h (J := J) K B E F τ dSq 0
+    (by intro j; simp [K, B, E, F])
+    (by intro j; simp [E, τ])
+    (by intro j; simp [F, dSq])
+  exact Bool.false_ne_true (by simpa [rejected, realize] using hh.1)
+
+def source_registration : Registration arena claim where
+  actual := actual
+  bridge := by
+    constructor
+    · intro h J inst K B E F τ dSq c hdecomp hE hF
+      exact ⟨rfl, h K B E F τ dSq c hdecomp hE hF⟩
+    · intro h J inst K B E F τ dSq c hdecomp hE hF
+      exact (h K B E F τ dSq c hdecomp hE hF).2
+  variation := ⟨actual_law, ⟨rejected, rejected_law⟩⟩
+  sensitivity := by
+    constructor
+    · intro i
+      refine ⟨rejected, ?_, rfl, rejected_law⟩
+      intro j hj
+      exact (hj (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
+    · intro i
+      exact nomatch i
+  dependence := by
+    intro i
+    refine ⟨(), False, True, ?_⟩
+    simp [actual, realize]
+

+      (@_root_.D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.FourPathNearestRayComparison.finite_family_error_aggregation)
+      (Realization signature) Unit Unit := {
+  unitName := `Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.FourPathNearestRayComparison.finite_family_error_aggregation.unit
+  realizationName := `Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.FourPathNearestRayComparison.source_registration
+  realizationSource := none
+  generated := false
+  arena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  objectArena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  catalog := Lean.Name.anonymous
+  localNames := false
+  realization := .source arena ⟨source_registration⟩
+  correspondence := { stage := .evidence, objectStage := .evidence }
+  bundleNonempty := .absent
+  readout := some (realize signature (fun _ _ b => b) (fun e _ => nomatch e))
+  variation := .absent
+  sensitivity := .absent
+  partialSensitivity := none
+  escapeFrom := none
+  sourceSelection := none
+  continuation := .unknown
+  familyRecord := none
+  options := #[] }
+
+abbrev mass_signature : Signature where
+  Params := Unit
+  State _ := Bool

+  finiteRole := inferInstance
+  nonemptyRole := inferInstance
+  Output _ _ := Bool
+  Anchor := Empty
+  finiteAnchor := inferInstance

+
+def mass_rejected : Realization mass_signature :=
+  realize mass_signature (fun _ _ _ => false) (fun e _ => nomatch e)
+
+abbrev mass_arena : Arena where
+  signature := mass_signature
+  Law obs := ∀ {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (p q : J → ℝ) (σ : J → Bool),
+    (hp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) → (hq : ∀ j, 0 ≤ q j) →
+    (hsumP : ∑ j, p j = 1) → (hsumQ : ∑ j, q j = 1) →
+    (hsel : ∀ j, (σ j = true ∧ q j ≤ p j) ∨ (σ j = false ∧ p j < q j)) →
+    (obs.readout () () true = true) ∧
+      (0 ≤ ∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) ∧
+        (∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) ≤ 1 ∧
+        (0 ≤ ∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) ∧
+        (∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) ≤ 1 ∧
+        (1 - ∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) +
+            (1 - ∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) =
+          ∑ j, min (p j) (q j)
+
+abbrev mass_claim : Prop := ∀ {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (p q : J → ℝ) (σ : J → Bool),
+    (∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ q j) →
+    (∑ j, p j = 1) → (∑ j, q j = 1) →
+    (∀ j, (σ j = true ∧ q j ≤ p j) ∨ (σ j = false ∧ p j < q j)) →
+    (0 ≤ ∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) ∧
+      (∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) ≤ 1 ∧
+      (0 ≤ ∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) ∧
+      (∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) ≤ 1 ∧
+      (1 - ∑ j, if σ j = true then p j else 0) +
+          (1 - ∑ j, if σ j = true then 0 else q j) =
+        ∑ j, min (p j) (q j)
+
+theorem mass_actual_law : mass_arena.Law mass_actual := by
+  intro J inst p q σ hp hq hsumP hsumQ hsel
+  exact ⟨rfl, selected_mass_bounds_and_defect p q σ hp hq hsumP hsumQ hsel⟩
+
+theorem mass_rejected_law : ¬ mass_arena.Law mass_rejected := by
+  intro h
+  let J := ULift Unit
+  have hh := h (J := J) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => true)
+    (by intro j; simp) (by intro j; simp)
+    (by simp) (by simp) (by intro j; simp)
+  exact Bool.false_ne_true (by simpa [mass_rejected, realize] using hh.1)
+

+    constructor
+    · intro h J inst p q σ hp hq hsumP hsumQ hsel
+      exact ⟨rfl, h p q σ hp hq hsumP hsumQ hsel⟩

+      exact (h p q σ hp hq hsumP hsumQ hsel).2
